summary: Razorpay Standard Checkout backend integration fully validated using real Razorpay Test API (no mocks). All 13 tests passed: create-order (happy + validation + auth), signature verify (valid HMAC, invalid, cross-user 403), appointment reference_id side-effect (paid=true + razorpay_payment_id persisted), /api/payments/mine listing, public checkout HTML page (valid + invalid order id 400), plus regressions on admin login/patients aggregation and Daily.co video session.
action_items: Frontend WebView payment flow requires manual real-device test with Razorpay test card 4111 1111 1111 1111 (any future date/CVV) — cannot be validated headlessly.

Consider adding an idempotency guard on /api/payments/verify: currently a second verify call with the same valid signature succeeds again (status stays paid, but log_activity would fire twice). Low priority.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1400+ lines; consider splitting payments/video/admin routers into separate modules.
verify_payment does not check that payment.status is still 'created' before marking paid — allows re-verify. Not exploitable (signature required) but unclean.

payment_checkout_page accepts amount/name/description as raw query params without cap — a malicious link could inject arbitrary display text into the WebView. Safe (JSON.stringify escapes), but consider max-length caps on name/description.
seed_data_creation: Tests create a fresh patient + doctor user per session and one appointment (id starts with uuid). Test payments left in db.payments with status=paid/created — user_id is a random test user, safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Razorpay flow is fully working server-side. Test keys rzp_test_TG0oQNJ3Lf8Xqi in backend/.env are valid. If main agent asks for WebView UI test, note that Razorpay Standard Checkout modal cannot be reliably driven by Playwright inside an Expo web preview because Razorpay's iframe blocks cross-origin scripting; manual device test needed. All other endpoints (video, admin, auth) regression-verified passing.
